title.en: An Act to Fix the Salaries of Undersecretaries of Executive Departments.

text.en:
The salaries of Department Undersecretaries are hereby fixed at eight thousand five hundred
pesos per annum each.

The funds necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Act are hereby appropriated out of
any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated.
All acts or parts of acts inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 28, 1928.
